about_the_game:
Is your RPG in dire need of dozens of colorful character faces? Look no further, the

TinyRPG - Face Pack I is here to tend to your needs!

 

In this pack one will find:

 

40 Characters Faces

●      7 Fighters

●      5 Bandits

●      5 Healers

●      5 Mages

●      5 Nobles

●      5 Villagers

●      3 Heroes

●      3 Merchants

●      2 Battle Mages

       

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

 

Characters (5 sheets)

●      Bandits,Battle Mages and Fighters (1 sheet)

●      Fighters andHealers (1 sheet)

●      Healers,Mages and Heroes (1 sheet)

●      Mages and Nobles (1 sheet)

●      Nobles and Villagers (1 sheets)

 

------------------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
